selection_principles: Retain one local-availability and one continuous-proximity indicator per component.
Exclude raw contextual lengths and municipal area from direct accessibility scoring.
Avoid deterministic count/presence and length/presence duplication.
Preserve excluded variables in the integrated matrix for sensitivity analysis.
Use hierarchical aggregation so components and modes, not variable counts, determine influence.

road_density_km_per_1000_km2.rationale: Area-adjusted road-network availability avoids raw municipal-size effects.

distance_to_mapped_road_km.rationale: Continuous measure of spatial separation from the mapped road network.

port_presence.rationale: Transparent local-availability measure; chosen instead of the highly skewed count.

distance_to_port_km.rationale: Continuous measure of access barrier to the nearest port facility.

passenger_crossing_presence.rationale: Local crossing availability; chosen instead of raw line length.

distance_to_passenger_crossing_km.rationale: Continuous measure of access barrier to a passenger-crossing line.

navigated_waterway_presence.rationale: Local navigated-waterway availability; chosen instead of raw segment length.

distance_to_navigated_waterway_km.rationale: Continuous measure of access barrier to a published navigated waterway.

decea_airport_presence.rationale: Transparent local airport availability; chosen instead of the correlated count.

distance_to_decea_airport_km.rationale: Continuous measure of spatial access barrier to the nearest DECEA/ICA airport.

excluded.road_federal_km: Raw contextual length and part of the constructed road total.
excluded.road_state_km: Raw contextual length and part of the constructed road total.
excluded.road_other_km: Raw contextual length, part of road total, and highly correlated with it.
excluded.road_paved_km: Raw contextual length affected by municipal extent; retain for sensitivity analysis.
excluded.road_unpaved_km: Raw contextual length affected by municipal extent; retain for sensitivity analysis.
excluded.road_total_km: Constructed sum of network classes and affected by municipal extent.
excluded.road_mapped_presence: Less informative than the retained continuous road density and distance measures.
excluded.road_federal_presence: Correlated with federal-road length and narrower than overall road accessibility.
excluded.road_state_presence: Narrower network-class indicator; retain for sensitivity analysis.
excluded.municipality_area_km2: Territorial denominator/context, not an accessibility indicator.
excluded.port_count: Deterministically linked to port presence and strongly right-skewed.
excluded.decea_airport_count: Deterministically linked to airport presence and correlated with it.
excluded.passenger_crossing_km: Deterministically linked to crossing presence and nearly perfectly correlated with it.
excluded.navigated_waterway_km: Deterministically linked to waterway presence and strongly correlated with it.

aggregation_constraint.reason: Water transport has three components while road and air have one each; flat aggregation would implicitly overweight water indicators.
